A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EgoSound study and contain readable main text, figures, tables, references, and seven-page supplementary material. Content can be matched reliably across the revisions and appendix renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of nine MLLMs and human performance in Table 3, an audio-only ablation in Figure 4, and qualitative failure analyses in the supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results and additionally reports human verification of dataset quality in Section 3.5.

M1.justification: The Qwen2.5-VL/Gemini/GPT-4o curation pipeline and generation prompts remain unchanged in Section 3.3 and Figures 6–7. The added human verification evaluates dataset quality without describing changes to generation or filtering.

E1.justification: Both versions use 900 videos from Ego4D and EgoBlind, 7315 QA pairs, and the same seven tasks. The verification study samples this retained coverage; the newly cited EPIC-SOUNDS dataset is not used experimentally.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains the same nine model configurations and human baseline. Figure 4 still ablates Qwen3-Omni-Thinking-30B, and comparator membership in the qualitative analyses is unchanged.

E3.justification: New Section 3.5 reports checking QA correctness against video and assigning 0–5 quality scores on 350 pairs. Balanced sampling of 50 pairs per task already appeared for human answering in v1; existing inference, model-scoring, and audio-only protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 3.5 adds a reported human audit testing the correctness and grounding of generated QA pairs. The audio-only ablation and all seven appendix failure-case analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added verification accuracy and average quality score are point estimates, and the two-evaluator information was already present.

E6.justification: Section 3.5 newly reports 92.1% QA-verification accuracy and a 4.3/5 average quality score. Table 3 and Figure 4 values are unchanged, including the 83.9% human and 56.7% Qwen3-Omni-Thinking-30B accuracies. The addition concerns annotation quality, not improved model performance.

T1.justification: Neither version contains formal theorems, proofs, or mathematical derivations. The task definitions remain unchanged; the added taxonomy design principles provide conceptual rationale.

C1.justification: Both retain the claims of a first egocentric sound-understanding benchmark, a seven-task taxonomy, a high-quality dataset, and persistent MLLM weaknesses. The verification results support the existing quality claim without redefining the contributions.

C2.justification: Section 3.5 newly interprets human-verification outcomes as evidence for the curation pipeline's reliability. Interpretations of model scaling, modality dependence, egocentric-model comparisons, and appendix failure mechanisms remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page URL to the abstract, providing new access information. The generation and evaluation prompts, GPU specifications, frame-sampling rates, and zero-shot inference details were already documented and remain in the renumbered appendices.

R1.justification: v2 adds EPIC-SOUNDS as reference 16 and cites it in Section 2. It also removes the specific GPT-4 audio–visual limitation example. The broader positioning remains stable; most other reference changes are renumbering or metadata edits.

P1.justification: Localized edits add taxonomy design principles, reorganize human-evaluation descriptions around Section 3.5, and shorten several passages. Affiliations and acknowledgments are updated, and supplementary Sections 7–8 become A–B. The overall narrative structure remains intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 revises an illustrative Ego4D example. Figure 3 moves chart titles above the plots and adds example-column headings while retaining the statistics. Text and acknowledgments shift position; no figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: Section 3.5 adds direct human evidence for annotation quality, whereas v1 reported human answering performance without a separate QA-quality audit. Clearer taxonomy rationale and Figure 3 labels also improve understanding. The verification study remains briefly documented, so these are useful but limited gains.
